calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal of the three-day mean intraday candle displacement, scaled by that day's high-low range. Clipping limits extreme candle artifacts and avoids price-level dependence. Higher values indicate stronger recent intraday selling pressure and expected next-day reversal.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.050632), 2023-2024 (+0.049050), and 2025-2027 (+0.044489). Predictive effect decays materially beyond one day; interpret conservatively given average 11.7 instruments.
